appName.title: App name
appName.description: Looked up on both stores (first App Store search hit, first Google Play search hit). Ignored for a platform whose id/URL you give.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de, jp…).

lang.title: Language (Google Play)
lang.description: Google Play review language (en, de, ja…). The App Store feed is per country, not per language.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: Oldest review date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Empty = no lower bound.

dateTo.title: Date to
dateTo.description: Newest review date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive). Empty = now.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per platform
maxReviews.description: App Store returns at most ~500 per country (Apple RSS limit).

summary.title: Write SUMMARY.md
summary.description: Weekly rating trend + complaint categories and keywords for ≤3★ reviews.
